🎥🎬: Family Guy Halloween Special (2026)

The Griffins are ready to celebrate Halloween, but in a family like theirs, even the simplest holiday plans can spiral completely out of control. Peter’s antics set off a chain of ridiculous events, turning the spooky season into a comedy of errors filled with unexpected surprises.
Meanwhile, Stewie’s mischievous personality and Brian’s trademark sarcasm add even more trouble to the mix. As the night unfolds, the family proves once again that no celebration is safe from their uniquely chaotic brand of humor.
